no tension placed on a transcervical balloon catheter
outcome: Time from catheter insertion to delivery
Time from insertion to catheter expulsion
cohort: 140 women who underwent cervical ripening with a Bishop score ≤6
finding: Applying tension to a transcervical balloon catheter during cervical ripening did not result in faster delivery times.
mod_finding: Application of tension to a transcervical balloon catheter during cervical ripening did not result in faster delivery times but did result in faster times to catheter expulsion.
